noAccess.title: No groups to maintain
noAccess.text: Groups are maintained here by the people who manage them. To manage a group, contact the ZWR or whoever manages it already.

list.title: Groups
list.intro: Groups whose members are maintained here: people, other groups and rules for whole address ranges, each with a role and, if wanted, until a date. Groups whose members may only be viewed are marked “view only”.
list.introAdmin: All groups of the source {{source}}. Groups from other sources (e.g. bwIDM) are maintained there and can be entered here as members.

create.title: Create Group
create.idHint: Becomes the token group:<identifier> by which rules name the group; cannot be changed later. Lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.
create.idInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore, starting with a letter or digit.
create.managersHint: People or groups allowed to maintain the members. Managing is not being a member.

delete.title: Delete Group?
delete.message: {{id}} is deleted with all its entries and removed from every other group. Rules in the services that name group:{{id}} no longer apply.

detail.readOnly: This group comes from the source {{source}} and is maintained there; it is read-only here.
detail.readOnlyViewers: This group comes from the source {{source}} and is maintained there; here only who may view its members can be set.
detail.viewOnly: Shared for viewing only: the entries and members of this group can be read, not changed here.
detail.emptyKept: This group is empty. If the source {{source}} no longer delivers it, it is only kept because of the entries under “View members”; once they are removed, the next sync deletes the group.

entries.hint: A group as entry makes all of its members members of this group, in the chosen role. An entry with an end date counts until the end of that day. The role can be changed right in the table; the end date stays.
entries.removeMessage: {{member}} loses the role “{{relation}}” in this group.

expiry.title: Change End Date
expiry.hint: Without a date the entry does not end. An expired entry counts again with a new date.

effective.hint_one: {{count}} person belongs to this group in the end, sub-groups included and expired entries not. Whoever belongs only through an address pattern is not listed.
effective.hint_other: {{count}} people belong to this group in the end, sub-groups included and expired entries not. Whoever belongs only through an address pattern is not listed.

managers.hint: Whoever manages a group maintains its entries, its description and who manages it. Managing is not being a member: nobody gains the group's rights by it.
managers.removeMessage: {{token}} can no longer manage this group.

viewers.hint: Whoever may view the members sees the entries of this group and all of its members, and those of every group it contains, at any depth. They cannot change anything and do not become members of the group.
viewers.none: Apart from the managers, nobody may view the members.
viewers.removeMessage: {{token}} can no longer view the members of this group.

actions.viewer_removed: {{member}} may no longer view the members

browser.intro: Groups of every source. Only the groups of {{source}} are maintained here; groups of other sources come from their import and are read-only here, except for who may view their members. Pick a group on the left.
